narr-intro.text: Princess Kathleen and Pip walked into the Twinkle Forest. It was getting dark, and the fireflies were all mixed up.
narr-intro.speaker: Narrator

fairy-intro.text: Let's catch the fireflies in our lantern, so we can see the way. Tap each one, and we'll count together!
fairy-intro.speaker: Pip

fairy-ten.text: Ten fireflies! Our lantern is glowing!
fairy-ten.speaker: Pip

fairy-animals.text: Oh no, three baby animals are lost! Can you take each baby to its mummy?
fairy-animals.speaker: Pip

fairy-match-owl.text: The baby owl found its mummy! Hoo hoo!
fairy-match-owl.speaker: Pip

fairy-match-rabbit.text: The bunny is home with its mummy!
fairy-match-rabbit.speaker: Pip

fairy-match-deer.text: The little fawn found its mummy deer!
fairy-match-deer.speaker: Pip

fairy-wrong.text: Hmm, that's not its mummy. Try another one!
fairy-wrong.speaker: Pip

narr-cry.text: Then, from far away, they heard a sound. Someone was crying... high up in a cave on Cloud Mountain.
narr-cry.speaker: Narrator

fairy-light.text: Let's take a firefly light with us. Tap the lantern, Kathleen!
fairy-light.speaker: Pip

fairy-light-got.text: A magic Firefly Light! Now let's find out who is crying.
fairy-light-got.speaker: Pip

narr-complete.text: So Princess Kathleen, Pip and their little light set off for Cloud Mountain... To be continued!
narr-complete.speaker: Narrator
